models.name: Toto-2
models.description: Datadog Toto 2.0 adapter for Gift-Eval-faithful zero-shot UV-UV runs. Defaults to Datadog/Toto-2.0-1B for Colab practicality; set TOTO2_CHECKPOINT=Datadog/Toto-2.0-2.5B for the highest-accuracy checkpoint.

default.notes: Practical Colab default using the official Toto2Model.forecast API, median quantile output, and a bounded 4096-step context cap for memory control.

highest_accuracy.notes: Highest-accuracy Toto 2.0 checkpoint reported by Datadog on GIFT-Eval; requires substantially more GPU memory.

official_capabilities.notes: Official Toto 2.0 model card describes univariate and multivariate zero-shot forecasting; current benchmark runner records only UV-UV.

models.name: TimesFM-2.5

official_capabilities.notes: Official TimesFM 2.x supports univariate forecasting and XReg/covariate workflows; current benchmark runner records UV-UV.

models.name: Granite-FlowState

models.name: TTM-R3-FT
models.description: IBM TinyTimeMixer R3 fine-tuned baseline appearing as TTM-R3-FT in GIFT-Eval run registries.

default.notes: TTM-R3-FT is the fine-tuned TinyTimeMixer R3 baseline referenced by GIFT-Eval-style run registries.

official_capabilities.notes: IBM TinyTimeMixer R3 model card describes zero-shot, few-shot, full fine-tuning, multivariate forecasting, and exogenous/control variables. The shared registry evaluation_modes field keeps only benchmark-run evaluation modes; few-shot support is retained in supports_few_shot. This registry entry represents the fine-tuned TTM-R3-FT baseline appearing in GIFT-Eval run registries.
